messages:
Leah (Partnerships): fyi Celestia sent final marketplace tile + co-branded solution brief. they want our full mark inside their "Partner Verified" badge and to pull a short quote from Mina for the PDF. can design + legal weigh in? links: /drive/Celestia/Celestia-Redwood-asset-pack-v2.pdf and thumb-preview.png

Ravi (Design): opening now. quick hits: badge crops our wordmark at 72px -> unacceptable. recommendation: use `redwood-monogram-white.svg` for badging on dark backgrounds, do not place full logotype inside circular badges. also the current badge color (#05314B) falls close to low contrast for small text. propose #0A3B60 instead.

Mina (Product): the quote they want: "Redwood helped us scale inferencing without compromise." i'm ok with that but they also suggested shortening to "Redwood scaled our inference." prefer to keep "without compromise."

Jordan (Legal): two required items: 1) written scope of use (assets, channels, duration). 2) explicit approval from Mina for any edited quote. I'll prepare a 1-paragraph quote license. we also need Celestia to include our trademark notice and a link to brand guidelines.

BrandBot: alt text suggestion: `Redwood + Celestia logos side-by-side with a dark teal header, joint solution for edge inference` :white_check_mark:

Ravi (Design): ask to Celestia (single list): 1) swap to `redwood-monogram-white.svg` for thumbnail/badge or provide a 144x144 PNG with 16px safe padding; 2) export marketplace PNG flattened at 72dpi and a separate 300dpi PDF for the one-pager; 3) shift quote block below header so header stays logo-only; 4) provide vectors (SVG/AI) not raster if possible.

Leah (Partnerships): I'll consolidate and send to Celestia. Jordan please paste the quote license text so I can include it in the email. Mina confirm the exact quote variant you approve. deadline: Celestia aims to publish next Wednesday so we'd like approvals by EOD Monday.

Jordan (Legal): draft license (pasteable): "Celestia Cloud is granted a limited, non-exclusive license to reproduce the approved quote from Mina [last name], Product Lead, solely in connection with the attached co-branded solution brief and Celestia marketplace listing. This license is revocable and limited to the assets and timeframe agreed in writing. Redwood reserves the right to require removal of the quote if used out of context or in a materially different setting."

Mina (Product): approved: "Redwood helped us scale inferencing without compromise." Raj on the account will confirm the performance claims if Celestia wants numbers.

MKT Bot: created PARTNER-2207 "Celestia co-brand asset approvals" assigned to Leah, Ravi, Jordan. deliverables suggested: 300dpi PDF, 144x144 marketplace tile, 1200x628 social image. due 2025-09-02.

Leah (Partnerships): perfect. I'll send consolidated email to Celestia with Ravi's asset list + Jordan's draft license + request for vectors + timeline. will update here after they reply. :rocket:
